text: Verified independent fast algorithm prototype while CR7 gate stays frozen. Source: Chaudhuri/Hu arXiv1810.11332 (biased estimator Eq3 and exact sorted partial sums; includes ties), Huo/Szekely arXiv1410.1503 and its published clarification. Derived Fenwick grouped-x prefix computation: Dxy=4*sum_{xj<xi,yj<yi}(xi-xj)(yi-yj)-2*(n*sum(xi*yi)-sum(x)*sum(y)); strict y ranks and batch equal x to avoid false zero-cost tie contributions. Sorted row sums supply biased covariance via Dxy-2*dot(rowX,rowY)/n+sum(rowX)*sum(rowY)/n^2; self products have closed-form univariate sums. Prototype /private/tmp/eyes4s-fast-dcor-prototype.py validated exact Fraction terms on exhaustive small integer arrays and floating normalized maps (ties, dense, near-uniform, sparse and wide-range). Maximum observed difference from quadratic correlation 2.5480225568363934e-13; operand reversal difference 1.4670556436335858e-14. Receipt /private/tmp/eyes4s-fast-dcor-prototype-receipt.json. Python timing is exploratory only, not Scala performance qualification. No production change yet. Next: compensated/shared Scala implementation, exact and 1e-12 portable conformance, O(n log n) complexity witness, explicit decision for retiring the default quadratic pair cap while honoring supplied caps.
